scope: 2024 full D2_100 random forest; three independently drawn training caches x three independently specified training seeds x three independent serving caches. Equal weight over four utility periods. Fixed nominal max_features=3 across arms; not equal actual compute.
uncertainty: Report full cube mean and paired record interval separately from (a) three factor-marginal means/SD/t2 intervals conditional on other fixed level sets, (b) three diagonal t=f=s replicate effects treated as independent joint-randomness replicates under the PRNG working model, with t2 interval for total algorithm+training-channel+serving-channel variation conditional on data/panel. Training seeds are fixed public integers; secret channel draws are independent. No 27-independent-replicate claim, no joint coverage, no variance-component identification.
threshold_scope: Illustrative cutoffs; neither practical requirements nor joint acceptance tests.
privacy_scope: Each candidate arm is an alternative package. Bound0/1/2 applies model plus one linked-score realization under joint two-bit replacement with public other fields/Y/IDs/rosters. TRAIN and utility IDs disjoint. Reused channel values are never recharged within the same candidate. Raw arms, labels, exact utility results and combined research archive have no recipient DP guarantee. Releasing all grid sanitized arms jointly composes to6 per record; all crossed sanitized candidates compose to12 per record on their roster or panel, not2; combining grids may compose further.
verification: Complete frozen fit grid; prediction IDs/shapes/ranges, exact hashes of predictions/model binaries/metadata; producer fit invariants; independent midrank AUC and paired influence implementation. No independent training replication or arbitrary information-flow proof.

reporting_amendment.reason: Strict repeated-omission bit equality fails for parallel floating-point sums; allow <=1e-12 only with exactly unchanged within-period ranks/ties. No score/model/estimand changes.

cross-none-f0.scope: Retain original multithreaded probabilities. Numerical summation roundoff allowed only when complete within-period ranks/ties remain unchanged, preserving every AUC structural component.
